up: Retrieve distinct approved drugs (max_phase = 4) whose mechanism of action is classified as 'CHELATING AGENT' (drug_mechanism.action_type = 'CHELATING AGENT'). For each drug-target pair, return the drug name (pref_name), drug ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles), target name (pref_name), and target ChEMBL ID (chembl_id). Join molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name AS drug_pref_name, md.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND dm.action_type = 'CHELATING AGENT'
